tokenId.description: Proxmox API token identifier in the format USER@REALM!TOKENID (for example root@pam!automation).

tokenSecret.description: Proxmox API token secret (UUID-like opaque value).

username.description: Optional Proxmox user principal for documentation purposes (USER@REALM portion of token_id).

realm.description: Optional Proxmox authentication realm (pam|pve|adipam|ldap|...) used by the token.

pveAuthTicket.description: Optional legacy PVE authentication cookie value, kept for future ticket-based flows.
